title: Cottonwood Riding Club
specs: 100-acre facility with indoor and outdoor arenas, polo arena, cross country course, conditioning track, clubhouse, pro shop, and trail access
Access to miles of scenic trails adjacent to Chatfield State Park
Riding lessons for ages 7 and up
Summer camps for kids aged 7 and up, any experience level
